title: Cebu tourism: Foreign visitors drive growth, arrivals up 27%

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Foreign tourist arrivals in Cebu Province rose by 27.28 percent from January to August 2026, helping push total tourist arrivals past the one-million mark, according to the Provincial Tourism Office (PTO). The province recorded 1,080,809 tourist arrivals during the eight-month period, more than the 958,317 recorded in the same period last year. The increase represents 12.78 percent growth overall, with foreign arrivals rising faster than domestic visitors during the period.
